name: Skipper Calum

intro.text: I fish for langoustines. Up at four, creels out, creels in. You've the look of a woman or man who does not get up at four. Battle?

win: Ah well. The sea's more forgiving than you.
after: A langoustine is a small lobster. It is not a prawn. You can say 'Dublin Bay prawn' and a Dubliner will hold you to it. Here we sell them to Spain.
